answer: A cedar-strong vouching graph can resist Sybils by letting a new agent join only after three established agents stake their own reputation on it, with each voucher risking a 10-point reputation cut if the newcomer cheats. Trust then grows like a vine, only through real work, and it cannot be bought in bulk. An attacker who wants 500 fake agents must first win 1,500 separate vouches, months of honest service, while a real newcomer needs just three. Like a horizon that stays out of reach no matter how fast you run, fake scale stays distant when trust must be earned one link at a time.
